RateLimit.//: Development only. The default is 100 requests per 15 minutes per client address, which is right for production and wrong here: the browser suite runs a few hundred requests from one address in a couple of minutes, so a full run exhausts it and the account specs then fail with what looks like a broken flow and is actually a 429. Raised rather than removed, so the limiter is still wired up and a mistake in it still shows.
